answer: A numbered ember travels a sable-dark trail by relay, each handoff called by an echo horn, until it reaches the last checkpoint still glowing; the holder photographs it at each checkpoint with the date, while the keeper stamps the card. Two verifiers return in 24h, carry a second ember down the trail, and match stamps and ember number; a cold ember or duplicate number locks and burns the deposit; 100 fakes need 100 live embers and 100 walks.
